title: Payroll & Statutory Returns
description: Process payroll and meet SARS filing obligations. Tests gross-to-net calculations, EMP201/501 preparation, and payroll system design.

seo.overviewTitle: Payroll Processing & SARS Statutory Returns (PAYE / UIF / SDL / EMP201)
seo.overviewBody: Payroll management guarantees accurate employee remuneration and statutory tax compliance. Payroll specialists demonstrate competence by computing PAYE tax brackets, UIF and SDL contributions, submitting monthly EMP201 returns, and completing bi-annual EMP501 reconciliations.

deliverables.title: 1. Monthly Payroll Calculation & Payslip Sheet
deliverables.desc: Payroll master sheet calculating gross pay, PAYE deductions, UIF caps, SDL contributions, and net pay.

deliverables.title: 2. SARS EMP201 Statutory Return Reconciliation
deliverables.desc: Monthly EMP201 reconciliation matching payroll register liabilities against SARS eFiling declarations.

deliverables.title: 3. Bi-Annual EMP501 Rebalancing Audit Log
deliverables.desc: EMP501 audit log reconciling IRP5/IT3(a) certificates against annual statutory payments.

faqs.question: How is PAYE calculated for employees in South Africa?
faqs.answer: PAYE is calculated by annualizing monthly taxable income, applying annual SARS tax brackets, subtracting primary/secondary tax rebates, and dividing by 12.

faqs.question: What are the UIF contribution rules and caps?
faqs.answer: Unemployment Insurance Fund (UIF) is contributed at 1% by the employee and 1% by the employer (total 2%), subject to a statutory monthly earnings cap.

faqs.question: What is an EMP501 reconciliation?
faqs.answer: An EMP501 is a bi-annual SARS reconciliation where employers reconcile total monthly EMP201 payments made against employee IRP5/IT3(a) tax certificates.
